name: Billy Doe Meats
verdict: Billy Doe Meats drove $7,148.81 in revenue at a 4.81 ROAS over 28 days, but the biggest concern is a 70.18% drop in ROAS week-over-week alongside a 21.43% decline in purchases, likely driven by rising spend concentration in the top "BWS - Sales - Muslims" campaign ($839.56) without a proportional return in the most recent 7-day window.

performance.verdict: ROAS collapse is real but 3-day purchases recovering; GBP dark is the urgent leak.

findings.text: ROAS fell 70.18% week-over-week while spend rose 28.1%; last 3 days (Sep 8–10) produced only 6 purchases vs 8 in prior 3 (Sep 5–7) — efficiency eroding, not recovering.
GBP actions zero for 4 consecutive days (Sep 7–10) after averaging 28/day prior 21 days — Google Business Profile appears dark or de-listed, organic discovery cut off.
5 overdue SOW milestones (Aug 14–Aug 31): Live-Cooking Shoot, Pre-Launch Gate, Platform Ownership, Funnel Test + UTM Live, SEO Phase 1 — none marked complete as of 2026-09-11.
Top campaign 'BWS - Sales - Muslims' consumed $839.56 of $1,485.91 (56%) in 28 days; single-campaign concentration at this share is a creative-fatigue risk given prior retargeting burnout history.
GA4 sessions held flat (-0.36%) while GBP went dark — suggests paid traffic is masking an organic collapse that will compound if Meta spend drops.

suggestions.text: Investigate and restore GBP listing immediately; 4 days dark costs ~28 actions/day in free discovery.
suggestions.monday_update: GBP actions have been zero for 4 straight days (Sep 7–10) after averaging 28/day across the prior 21 days — the profile is dark or suspended. Nacer to check GBP dashboard for suspension notice or ownership issue and restore today. Success check: GBP actions return to ≥15/day within 3 days of fix (confirm by Sep 14).

suggestions.text: Hold Meta spend flat; watch purchases over next 3 days before any scale — ROAS floor not confirmed.
suggestions.monday_update: 28-day ROAS is 4.81 but collapsed 70.18% week-over-week while spend rose 28.1%; last 3 days show only 6 purchases vs 8 the prior 3. Do not increase budget on 'BWS - Sales - Muslims' until ROAS stabilises above 3.0 on a 7-day basis. Re-check on Sep 14 — if ROAS holds or recovers, a ≤20% scale is defensible; if it declines further, a creative refresh is the next move.

suggestions.text: Escalate all 5 overdue SOW milestones to Nacer; Funnel Test + UTM Live is blocking attribution truth.
suggestions.monday_update: Five milestones are overdue by 10–28 days: Live-Cooking Shoot (Aug 14), Pre-Launch Gate, Platform Ownership, Funnel Test + UTM Live, and SEO Phase 1 Guardrails (all Aug 31). The Funnel Test closure is a direct attribution blocker — Meta purchase events fire inconsistently via Shopify and UTM gaps make ROAS reads unreliable. Nacer to assign owners and deadlines for each item by Sep 12; completion of Funnel Test + UTM confirmed by UTM data appearing in Windsor within 48 hours of go-live.
